article.story: JACKSONVILLE, Fla. -- — Simm-Marten Saadi’s 20 points helped Central Arkansas defeat North Florida 80-66 on Monday. Saadi shot 5 of 11 from the field, including 5 for 10 from 3-point range, and went 5 for 6 from the line for the Bears (4-3). Tucker Anderson scored 16 points, going 6 of 8 (4 for 5 from 3-point range). Ty Robinson went 7 of 16 from the field (2 for 7 from 3-point range) to finish with 16 points. Ayuba Bryant Jr. finished with 16 points and 10 rebounds for the Ospreys (3-4). Elijah Elliott added 13 points and Mason Lee contributed 11 points and two steals. Up next: Central Arkansas’ next game is Saturday against Southwestern Christian at home, and North Florida hosts Warner on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
